co_payment_conditions.value: 20% on each and every Claim arising in such regard

room_rent_limit.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'

icu_limit.quote: The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'

initial.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded

pre_existing.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months

specific_diseases.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage

maternity.quote: Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy

pre_hospitalization.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital

post_hospitalization.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital

day_care.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person for Medical Expenses incurred on all Day Care Treatments through Cashless or Reimbursement Facility, maximum up to the Sum Insured

ambulance.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person, through Cashless or Reimbursement Facility, up to the Sum Insured

restoration.value: Unlimited automatic recharge up to base sum insured unlimited times
restoration.quote: the Company agrees to automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year

cumulative_bonus.value: 50% flat per year, up to 100% max
cumulative_bonus.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis, as a Cumulative Bonus... shall not exceed 100%

ayush.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... up to the Sum Insured... towards Medical Expenses incurred with respect to the Insured Person's medical treatment undergone at any AYUSH Hospitals

modern_treatments.value: Covered up to sum insured for specified methods
modern_treatments.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the Sum Insured... for expenses incurred under Benefit 'Hospitalization expenses ' for treatment taken through following advance technology methods

maternity_cover.quote: Medical treatment expenses traceable to childbirth (including complicated deliveries and caesarean sections incurred during hospitalization) except ectopic pregnancy

key_exclusions.value: Obesity treatment excluded unless specific BMI and co-morbidity conditions are met

key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to any treatment, including surgical management, to change characteristics of the body to those of the opposite sex.

key_exclusions.value: Hazardous or adventure sports as a professional excluded

key_exclusions.name: Hazardous Sports

key_exclusions.quote: Expenses related to sterility and infertility. This includes... Assisted Reproduction services
key_exclusions.name: Sterility and Infertility

planned_intimation.value: At least 48 hours prior to planned date of admission
planned_intimation.quote: the Company shall be notified either at the Company's call center or in writing at least 48 hours prior to planned date of admission to Hospital

emergency_intimation.quote: within 48 hours of Hospitalization commencing or before the Insured Person's discharge from Hospital.

reimbursement_documents.quote: within 30 days of Insured Person's discharge from Hospital.

free_look_period.quote: The Insured Person shall be allowed free look period of 30 days from date of receipt of the policy document

grace_period.quote: can be renewed within the Grace Period of 30 days to maintain continuity of benefits without break in policy.

moratorium_period.quote: After completion of five continuous years under the policy no look back to be applied. This period of five years is called as moratorium period.

summary.overview: Care Supreme is a comprehensive health insurance policy offering no limits on room rent and ICU charges, along with extensive pre and post-hospitalization coverage and unlimited automatic recharges of the sum insured. It features robust wellness benefits and modular optional covers.
best_for: Individuals seeking comprehensive coverage with zero room rent restrictions
Families looking for high sum insured options with automatic recharges
Buyers wanting extensive pre and post-hospitalization durations
watch_outs: Smart Select option imposes a 20% co-payment if treated at non-listed hospitals
Strict notification timeline of 48 hours for hospitalization intimation
Specific named ailment waiting period of 24 months for common surgeries like cataract and joint replacement
next_actions: Review the list of network hospitals and Smart Select hospital exclusions
Verify waiting periods for any pre-existing conditions
Ensure compliance with the 48-hour claim intimation rule in case of hospitalization

risks.title: 20% co-payment: Smart Select non-listed hospitals
risks.explanation: A 20% co-payment applies when this condition is met (20% on each and every Claim arising in such regard).
risks.quote: If the Insured Person takes Medical Treatment in hospitals other than those listed in Annexure – III... shall bear a Co-Payment of 20% on each and every Claim

risks.title: Pre-existing diseases covered only after 3 years
risks.explanation: Any illness you had before buying the policy is not covered until this period of continuous cover is complete.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months

risks.title: Strict 48-Hour Claim Intimation
risks.explanation: Failure to notify the insurer within 48 hours of emergency hospitalization or before planned admission can jeopardize claim admissibility as it is a condition precedent.
risks.quote: within 48 hours of Hospitalization commencing or before the Insured Person's discharge from Hospital.

risks.title: 2 years wait for listed diseases/procedures
risks.explanation: Treatments on the specific list (e.g. Arthritis, Cataract, Benign Prostatic Hypertrophy, Hemorrhoids / Piles) are not covered in this period.
risks.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
